summary.name: Increment: Planning (Issue 19)
summary.one_liner: Increment magazine's November 2021 issue on software planning, a collection of essays on how engineering teams plan products, roadmaps, and milestones.
use_cases: Learning how engineering teams approach software planning
Reading about roadmap creation as an individual contributor
Exploring product management basics for engineers
Finding ideas for planning milestones and managing tech debt
summary.what_it_does: This is the Planning issue (Issue 19, November 2021) of Increment, a print and digital magazine about how teams build and operate software systems at scale. It contains a list of essays on topics including tech debt, roadmap planning for individual contributors, a primer on product management for engineers, using RFCs for decisions, and planning for privacy. Several articles are described as interviews or staff snapshots, such as a look at planning at Netflix, Mailchimp, Asana, and LaunchDarkly, and an interview with YouTrack's Elena Pishkova about planning in public. The page also links to other issues and a store for print copies.
notable: Covers 18 essays and interviews on software planning from multiple authors
Includes a snapshot of planning practices at companies such as Netflix, Mailchimp, Asana, and LaunchDarkly
Part of a 19-issue magazine archive covering topics from on-call to containers
Print edition available through the Increment store
caveats: Print edition must be purchased separately from the Increment store
Page text shows only the issue table of contents and article blurbs, not full article content
